title: The front row learned every time zone
governingQuestion: What did Milan preserve when the runway became a platform?
status: evidence-backed draft; recording, named interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: The front row learned every time zone
longform.opening: In 2020, Milan rebuilt the front row as a platform that never slept.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: CNMI says its 2020 Digital Fashion Hub was designed and developed with Accenture, supported by Microsoft technology, with requirements work by PwC.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: The 2020 platform ran continuously across time zones and supported scheduled brand storytelling, while CNMI also published a multibrand virtual-showroom video.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: A permanent future supplier stack or successor platform is not inferred from the 2020 announcement.

longform.closing: Milan’s technology is not futurist decoration. It is the system that moves authority from name to room to object to record.

spokenScript: In 2020, Milan rebuilt the front row as a platform that never slept.
CNMI says its 2020 Digital Fashion Hub was designed and developed with Accenture, supported by Microsoft technology, with requirements work by PwC.
The 2020 platform ran continuously across time zones and supported scheduled brand storytelling, while CNMI also published a multibrand virtual-showroom video.
The system: Digital Fashion Hub, livestream, VOD.
The proof: Milano Digital Fashion Week.
The limit: A permanent future supplier stack or successor platform is not inferred from the 2020 announcement.
Open the Milan evidence edition: every receipt and permission is attached.
